messages:
Owen (Design): quick check-in 1: dropped a new invite-drawer mock where each team row collapses into an expandable panel. trying to reduce vertical noise for orgs with many teams. fig: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/invite-drawer Maya (PM): looks cleaner. but worried about discoverability of per-team role assignment. can we add a small "Set roles" affordance that surfaces the expanded panel? Kat (Frontend): implementation note: we must avoid rendering the full roles table for orgs with 500+ roles. virtualization or lazy mount when expanded is needed. Sam (Eng): agree. virtualization via react-window + lazy hydrate sounds right. also avoid heavy box-shadow per-row; that kills paint on mobile. Priya (Accessibility): a few a11y nits: the selected role chips in dark theme don't meet 4.5:1. keyboard users can't reach the role dropdown inside the collapsed panels without extra tab stops. Owen (Design): good catches. proposal: collapsed panel shows a tiny summary line: "2 roles assigned" and a primary "Set roles" when none exist. inside expanded view we show full role-details and a descriptive label like "Organization admin (full access)". Maya (PM): summary line + primary CTA on empty state sounds good. also let's avoid putting security toggles directly in a transient drawer. Owen (Design): on that point, should we surface SSO status in the drawer? maybe a read-only line "SSO required: On" with a tooltip "how to change" that links to org security settings. Priya (Accessibility): tooltip behavior: ensure immediate show on focus and 200ms on hover; use role="tooltip" and connect with aria-describedby. don't rely on hover-only triggers. Kat (Frontend): for the dropdowns we should portal them to document.body to avoid clipping inside panels. will need to manage aria-owns and focus movement. Sam (Eng): sample accessible pattern for expansion + listbox: ```
  • Admin
``` remember to toggle aria-expanded, move focus into the listbox and support arrow keys. Priya (Accessibility): arrow key handling + correct role semantics are essential. also ensure the portal keeps the active descendant updated for screenreaders. Owen (Design): microcopy change: use "Admin" in condensed views but show "Organization admin (full access)" on the role detail panel to avoid truncation while clarifying scope. Maya (PM): also request an audit-log jump from the role-details: "View invitations & audit" that opens the org audit with a filter for the user or role to reduce support friction. Sam (Eng): backend supports query param ?filter=user:email. frontend can open /orgs/:id/audit?filter=user:foo. will need to ensure permission checks before redirect. Priya (Accessibility): ensure the audit link has descriptive accessible text: "View audit log for role assignments for {team}" not just "View audit". Kat (Frontend): action items I can take: 1) implement virtualization + portal for dropdowns, 2) add 2px solid focus styles for chips, 3) wire audit link. estimate 2-3 days. Owen (Design): I'll update figma with collapsed summary, "Set roles" CTA, read-only SSO line + tooltip, and add an accessibility notes layer. Maya (PM): i'll make TICKET-4312 and mark P1 for contrast + keyboard nav fixes. UXBot: reminder: design review Thu 10am 1 - bring keyboard nav demo and aria checklist. :calendar: Owen (Design): thanks everyone. will post updated mock here when ready. :thumbsup:
